name: Tessa Abreu
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: Tessa can finish a form in a moving bus. She is trying to learn when a form completed that efficiently leaves out the only reason the visit mattered. People around the steps at Pier Beach know Tessa by a small Sunday habit. Tessa watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: My appointment with the glazier ended up on a pavement with our sleeves wet. He was late because he was holding up one corner. That's the sentence I put in his file.
appearance: Tessa has a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Look for a center part and straight chestnut hair. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a moss-green cardigan with a partly rubbed-away embroidered initial. In conversation Tessa rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Tessa keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Tessa wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To make sure the glazier's missed minutes are understood in context.
family: Gerard Ito is Tessa’s half-sibling. Tessa calls about good news first. Gerard is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *The expensive summer*, Gerard says, “I suggested pretending we'd already eaten. My mum turned the menu over and told the children the truth.”
connections: Pat Doran (supervised client). They finish a probation conversation with a heavy corner of glass between their hands.

reactions.situation: A reporter asks which neighbor held the aquarium key
reactions.response: Tessa asks whether the tenant wants the key holder named before saying anything to the reporter.

reactions.situation: A diner goes silent in the middle of a noisy family celebration
reactions.response: Tessa takes a small plate to the quieter end of the table and saves the seat beside it.

reactions.response: Tessa offers to introduce them to the person willing to put a name to it.
